Update your phone before leaving Wireless debugging on
This phone’s security update is from 2023-09-05. Android 14 to 16 need the May 2026 update (or a newer Google Play system update) to close a Wireless debugging flaw (CVE-2026-0073): without it, a device on the same Wi-Fi can get in without pairing. Until you update, turn Wireless debugging off when you are not using it, and leave auto-reconnect after reboot off.

Set up once — about a minute
Innocent connects to this phone's own Wireless debugging to open Android/data — no computer, no root.
